articles.summary: Capri Holdings Limited (NYSE: CPRI), a global fashion luxury group, today announced the appointment of Catherine So as Chief Legal and Sustainability Officer, effective October 19, 2026. Ms. So will report to John D. Idol, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of Capri Holdings.
